Aberdeen Group Names Torbjorn Magnusson as Chairman
Aberdeen Group appointed Torbjorn Magnusson as  chair-designate and nonexecutive director with immediate effect.
The London-listed asset manager said Wednesday that Magnusson would take over as chair of the board after regulatory approvals are secured.

Douglas Flint stepped down as chairman in April. Since then, Jonathan Asquith has been serving as interim chairman and will remain in that role until Magnusson's appointment becomes effective, the company said.
Magnusson is currently a nonexecutive director at Canopius Group, Aberdeen said. He recently stepped down as a nonexecutive director at Hastings Group, where he was previously chairman.
